response.justification: Despite extensive full-stack and open-source experience, the candidate lacks demonstrable C++ expertise in industrial automation, real-time systems, or secure embedded development — core requirements for this role. His C++ exposure is limited to a brief NI LabWindows stint over a decade ago, with no recent work on multi-threaded, message-brokered, or IEC 62443-compliant systems. His current stack is dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with no evidence of cloud-native C++ architecture, MQTT/REST IoT integration, or industrial cybersecurity practices.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems
Strong open-source contributions and technical documentation skills
Proven ability to lead and mentor via workshops and community initiatives
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ development in the last 9+ years
Lacks exposure to industrial IoT protocols (MQTT, OPC UA, IEC 61850, etc.)
No evidence of SDL or IEC 62443-4-1 compliance experience
